name: RMIT Indigenous Commonwealth Education Scholarship
summary: Up to $7,000 a year for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander RMIT students in financial hardship or who moved from regional areas.
key: Up to $7,000 a year full-time, or $3,500 part-time.
who: Identifies as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander and is an Australian citizen.
Enrolling in an associate, bachelor or postgraduate coursework program in Semester 1 2027.
Financial hardship, or moved from a rural or regional area to Melbourne in the last four years.
how: Apply direct to RMIT online (preferred) or through VTAC.
catches: The page shows conflicting headline totals, so check the amount.

evidence.quote: Up to $7,000 per year ($3,500 per semester) for full-time enrolled students (for the standard duration of program)
